title: Broken bleed line cuts F-18 control lines on Saudi Arabia training run
place_text: Saudi Arabia training range / aircraft carrier

tellings.quote: things. One of those had broken and it was essentially like a plasma beam just cutting things inside the jet.

plain: On a training run over a range in Saudi Arabia, a broken bleed line, a pipe carrying very hot air from the engine, acted "like a plasma beam just cutting things inside the jet" and cut through an F-18 fighter's control lines. Ryan Graves, a Navy fighter pilot, tells Michels this as something he lived through, a story about how close a jet can come to disaster.
